technical_issues.issue: RAAN value 27.33° described as launch facility location; RAAN sets orbit plane orientation relative to vernal equinox, not launch site latitude. Also argument of latitude used without defining time epoch.
Selection of future Vega-E with no performance/ mass capability check; piggyback compatibility analysis limited to orbit type not mass/volume/loads.
Proposes uncontrolled drag sail deorbit from 600km but no delta-V, area, or lifetime/25-year rule calculation provided.

overall: Strong mission rationale for GBR bleaching with single SSO satellite, good STK support and end-to-end design. Presentation and referencing weaken report; some orbital mechanics descriptions inaccurate but core design sound.

feedback.summary: You produced a strong end-to-end design for a single SSO satellite to monitor GBR bleaching using fluid lensing, supported by STK. Your mission rationale, launch, orbit and ground contact analysis are comprehensive. To improve, correct orbital mechanics descriptions and add quantitative justification for EOL and launch selection, and improve figure and reference formatting.
